profile.name: Darell Randy Pramudianto
profile.headline: Informatics Student & Creative Developer
about: I’m an Informatics student who combines software development, UI/UX design, and visual creativity to build functional, intuitive, and visually engaging digital experiences.
I enjoy turning ideas into reality through code and design, combining logical problem-solving with visual storytelling to create digital projects that are both functional and engaging.

research.narrative: I’m interested in building digital experiences that combine software engineering, thoughtful UI/UX design, and visual creativity to solve real-world problems in intuitive and engaging ways.

focus.name: Software Development
focus.description: Building practical applications and software solutions through programming, problem-solving, and continuous experimentation.

focus.name: UI/UX Design
focus.description: Designing intuitive user interfaces and engaging user experiences by combining visual aesthetics, usability, and user-centered thinking.

focus.name: Graphic Design
focus.description: Creating compelling visual designs through thoughtful composition, typography, color theory, and consistent visual identity.

focus.name: Video Editing
focus.description: Editing video content through pacing, storytelling, sound design, and visual techniques to create engaging and polished results.

projects.name: Flawless Prison
projects.summary: A Python-based 2D game built with Pygame, featuring interactive gameplay, challenges, and a boss battle. This project explores game development fundamentals, programming logic, and interactive design.

projects.name: Cinema Ticket
projects.summary: A C++ console-based cinema ticket booking system that allows users to select movies, choose ticket quantities, calculate total prices, and repeat bookings through an interactive menu.

footer: Building ideas through code, design, and creativity.
